'''Lloda''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Lloda was surprised how well the [[spear gun]] element of a [[Firearc49 Speargun]] functioned outside water.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
